sub: A role is a set of permissions. A staff member can hold several roles. The server checks every request; this page only decides what each role may do.
pick_text: Choose a role from the list to see and change its permissions.
delete_text: Only a role that nobody holds can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
system_note: The Owner role holds every permission and cannot be changed or deleted.
name: Role name
name_needed: Write a name for the role.
cannot_give: You cannot give a permission you do not hold.
changed_meanwhile: Someone else changed this role meanwhile. Their version is shown now; nothing was saved. Make your change again.
discard_text: Your changes to this role are not saved yet.
note: You can only give permissions you hold yourself. A change takes effect on each holder's next request.
